chunks: Asbāṭ, the seller of al-Zuṭṭī, informed me, saying:
I was in the presence of Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), and a man asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“Surely in that are signs for those who discern; and surely it is on an enduring road.”
He said: “We are the ones who discern, and the path abides in us.”

key_terms.آيَاتٍ: signs that indicate divine truth and guidance
key_terms.السَّبِيلُ: the path, meaning the way of divine guidance
key_terms.الْمُتَوَسِّمُونَ: those who discern signs and recognize realities by their marks
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the speech of Allah, referring here to the Qur’anic verse

ai.seo_question: Who are the “distinguishers” mentioned in Qur’an 15:75 according to Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the Qur’anic verse by Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام), identifying the true possessors of discernment as the Imams. It also links the abiding path to them, indicating that divine guidance and the straight way are established through them.
